beats.speaker: Doctor
beats.dialogue: …procedure status stable…some involuntary muscle activation in upper extremities, closing the incisi- Nurse, anesthesia report?
beats.stageDirection: The doctor pauses and sounds mildly frustrated before asking the nurse.

beats.speaker: Nurse
beats.dialogue: He’s supposed to be out, his vitals need to be recalibrated.

beats.speaker: Doctor
beats.dialogue: Addendum to Log 48 of procedure… ...subject exhibiting signs of e. delirium, reworking levels, procedure still viable. Will proceed with Stage 2 once the subject settles. End log. Nurse, can you expedite the process? Nurse!
beats.stageDirection: Jett screams in the background. The doctor sighs with boredom, a recorder clicks, and the doctor resumes with frustration.

beats.speaker: Jett
beats.dialogue: Everything hurts, there’s a burning, slippery liquid on me……gasoline smell.…or may..be..…iron……….help

beats.speaker: Nurse
beats.dialogue: Restraints still intact, he’s going out again.

beats.speaker: Doctor
beats.dialogue: Finally, no time to waste. Initializing Stage 2. Scalpel….
